generation.prompt_exact:
Make one complete transparent-alpha sprite of a BLACK SAGE shrub, botanical species Salvia mellifera, a native Southern California coastal sage scrub plant. This is detailed naturalistic pixel art for a calm garden game: crisp small square pixel clusters, careful stepped contours, restrained organic shading, subtle outline, warm light from upper left, three-quarter side garden view with slight top visibility. No painterly gradients, photo, UI, text, animals, birds, backdrop, ground rectangle or checkerboard.

A low rounded woody shrub with many small narrow oval DARK GREEN WRINKLED leaves, warm brown woody stems visible near base, thin upright flower stalks bearing small widely-spaced SPHERICAL WHORLS of tiny PALE WHITE to very pale LAVENDER flowers. Flower clusters arranged as small separated beadlike balls along stems, never large violet spikes. Healthy flowering specimen. Clearly dark small-leaf sage rather than pale white sage or Cleveland sage. Natural root collar and few tiny pebbles only at ground contact. Entire shrub and every stalk tip visible, occupying at most 72 percent width and 75 percent height, with generous transparent margins on every side. One flattened whole sprite, no independently separated layers implied. Fine botanical pixel detail suitable for placing behind birds in a San Diego yard.
